status: Default ladder. Thresholds, settings and patterns are starting values to be tuned on a validation split. 2026-10-11: BERT wins at >= bert_high, or at >= bert_low with a lead of >= bert_lead over its second choice. Set to 0.50 / 0.25 after retraining (the first model's top probabilities were only 15-25%, when 0.20 / 0.10 was used).

inputs.bert: model_type with a confidence (softmax probability). Implies page_type; implies page_subtype only when page_type is Progress Note.
inputs.keyword: page_subtype with a score, a margin and a title_hit flag (from keyword_canon.json). Implies page_type and model_type.
inputs.page_order: chart_id and page_index for every page. Needed only by level 3.

level_1_page_type.name: agreement
level_1_page_type.when: BERT and keyword give the same page_type

level_1_page_type.name: bert_high
level_1_page_type.when: they differ and BERT confidence >= bert_high, or BERT confidence >= bert_low with a lead >= bert_lead over BERT's second choice

level_1_page_type.name: keyword_only_class
level_1_page_type.when: they differ, the keyword page_type is a class BERT was not trained on (too few images), and keyword score >= keyword_min_score with title_hit

level_1_page_type.name: keyword_title
level_1_page_type.when: they differ, BERT not high (step 2 did not apply), keyword has title_hit and margin >= keyword_min_margin

level_1_page_type.name: bert_medium
level_1_page_type.when: they differ and BERT confidence >= bert_low

level_1_page_type.name: keyword_body
level_1_page_type.when: BERT confidence < bert_low and keyword score >= keyword_min_score

level_2_page_subtype: If the winning page_type is Progress Note: use BERT's model_type when BERT's page_type is Progress Note; otherwise use the keyword sub-type when it belongs to Progress Note; otherwise the generic sub-type.
For any other winning page_type: use the keyword sub-type when it belongs to that page_type and its score >= keyword_min_score; otherwise the generic sub-type (same name as the page type).

level_3_continuation.what: A pass over the pages of one chart, in page order, after levels 1 and 2 have given every page a per-page result. It works out which pages continue a document that started on an earlier page, then makes two decisions about Progress Note. It changes nothing else.
decisions: Progress Note or not: an untitled page that reads like a Progress Note may be a later page of another document. If so it takes that document's page type.
Embedded lab or radiology: a Laboratory Data or Radiology Report page that is part of a Progress Note becomes page_type Progress Note with that name as its page_subtype.
level_3_continuation.needs: chart_id and page_index for every page. Pages with no known order (for example single phone photos) skip steps A and B: continuation_link = 'not_checked', and only decision rule 3 (same page) can apply to them.
page_counter_rules: Read a 'Page k of N' counter from the page text with the page_counter pattern.
Ignore a counter on a line that matches fax_or_time_line: that is a fax banner counting the whole transmission.
Ignore a counter whose N is above max_document_pages: that counts a whole chart or export, not one document.
If several usable counters remain, use the one with the smallest N.

step_a_link_to_previous_page.how: P is the page being checked, Q is the page just before it in the same chart (page_index - 1). The first rule that applies decides. With no Q, P starts a document.

rules.name: numbering_continues
rules.when: Q's counter is page k of N and P's counter is page k+1 of the same N

rules.name: continued_heading
rules.when: a line of at most 8 words in P's title zone matches continued_heading, or one of Q's last lines matches continued_on_next

rules.name: own_title
rules.when: P has a title term in its title zone (keyword_title_hit is true)

rules.name: previous_ended
rules.when: Q's counter says page N of N

rules.name: weak_signals
rules.when: at least weak_signals_needed of: (a) P's first body line starts with a lower-case letter, or Q's last body line does not end with sentence punctuation; (b) P's first heading matches late_section_heading and Q has no closing match in its last lines; (c) one of the first or last edge_lines lines of P matches one of Q's, after removing digits, with similarity >= header_similarity

step_b_build_documents: A document is a start page plus every page linked after it, one after another. A document stops growing at max_document_pages; the next page starts a new one.
A page's link strength is strong only if every link between the start page and that page is strong; otherwise weak.

The start is confirmed when the start page has a title term in its title zone or its counter says page 1. If it is not confirmed, the document's page type is unknown: the real first page is probably missing.
The document's page type is the start page's per-page page_type from level 1.

step_c_decide.how: Check the rules in order for every page; the first that applies decides. 'Per-page' means the result of levels 1 and 2.

rules.name: continuation
rules.when: the page is not the start of its document, its link strength is strong, the start is confirmed, the page's per-page page_type is Progress Note, it has no title term in its own title zone, and the document's page type is not Progress Note
rules.result: The page is not a Progress Note. page_type = the document's page type. page_subtype = the keyword sub-type if it belongs to that page type with score >= keyword_min_score, otherwise the start page's page_subtype.

rules.name: embedded_in_document
rules.when: the page is not the start of its document, its link strength is strong, the start is confirmed, the page's per-page page_type is in embedded_page_types, and the document's page type is Progress Note
rules.result: page_type = Progress Note. page_subtype = the page's per-page page_type (Laboratory Data or Radiology Report). model_type = the same name.

rules.name: embedded_same_page
rules.when: the page's per-page page_type is in embedded_page_types, and on that same page the keyword model's page_type is Progress Note with title_hit (a note title at the top, lab or radiology content below). Needs no page order.

rules.name: possible
rules.when: rule 1 or rule 2 would have applied but the link strength is weak or the start is not confirmed

rules.name: no_change
rules.when: everything else, including an untitled Progress Note page that continues a Progress Note or continues nothing
rules.result: Keep the per-page result. is_continuation and document_start are still recorded.

level_4_codability: Read codability from the final page_type, after level 3. No model predicts it. An embedded lab or radiology page is therefore codable as Progress Note.
model_type_of_final_answer: page_subtype when page_type is Progress Note, otherwise page_type. For an embedded page this gives Laboratory Data or Radiology Report, the same class BERT predicts for a stand-alone one.
